title: ficinia tristachya subvar. micrantha
intro: Ficinia tristachya subvar. micrantha, commonly known as the Small-flowered Ficinia or Small-flowered Fimbry, is a perennial plant species within the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in South African folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Ficinia tristachya subvar. micrantha include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
